रथचित्रा

RATHACITRĀ . A river famous in the Purāṇas. (bhīṣma Parva, Chapter 9, Verse 26).

रथध्वज

RATHADHVAJA . Father of king kuśadhvaja of videha. vedavatī was his grand-daughter. (See under vedavatī).

रथध्वान

RATHADHVĀNA . Another name of Vīrāgni, son of śaṁyu. (Vana Parva, Chapter 219, Verse 9).

रथाग्रणी

RATHĀGRAṆĪ . A warrior. He had accompanied śatrughna who led the Aśvamedhic horse of rāma. (padma purāṇa, Pātālakhaṇḍa).

रथकृत

RATHAKṚTA . A yakṣa who rotates in the month of Caitra along with the āditya called dhātā. (bhāgavata 12th skandha).

रथाक्ष

RATHĀKṢA . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 63).

रथन्तर १

RATHANTARA I . A Sāman, which, having assumed form, worships brahmā in his court. (Sabhā Parva, Chapter 11, Verse 30). This rathantara sāman possesses the power to cure fainting fits. Once vasiṣṭha restored indra to consciousness with this Sāman. (śānti Parva, Chapter 281, Verse 21).

रथन्तर २

RATHANTARA II . Son of the agni called pāñcajanya. He was also called Tarasāhara. (Vana Parva, Chapter 222, Verse 7).

रथन्तर्या

RATHANTARYĀ (rathantarī) . Mother of King duṣyanta. She was the daughter of King īlina and had five sons, i.e. duṣyanta, śūra, bhīma, pravasu and vasu. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 94).

रथप्रभु

RATHAPRABHU . A synonym of Vīrāgni, son of śaṁyu. (Vana Parva, Chapter 219, Verse 9).

रथसेन

RATHASENA . A valiant warrior who fought on the Pāṇḍava side against the kauravas. His horses were very magnificent ones. (droṇa parva, Chapter 23, Verse 62).

रथस्थ

RATHASTHA . A yakṣa who rotates in the month of jyeṣṭha in the company of the āditya called mitra. (bhāgavata, 12th skandha).

रथस्था

RATHASTHĀ . One of the seven tributaries of the gaṅgā. According to the ancients, bathing in the river will wash off all sins. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 169, Verse 20).

रथातिरथसंख्यानपर्व

RATHĀTIRATHASAṄKHYĀNAPARVA . A sub-Parva of śānti Parva, Chapters 165-172.

रथवाहन

RATHAVĀHANA . Brother of the virāṭa King. He fought against the pāṇḍavas. (droṇa parva, Chapter 158, Verse 42).

रथावर्त

RATHĀVARTA . A holy place considered to be on the right side of Śākambharīdevī. He who visits this place will, due to the grace of śiva, attain salvation. (Vana Parva, Chapter 84, Verse 23).

रथवीति

RATHAVĪTI . A maharṣi. He lived in a hilly region very far away from the Himālayas. Once the maharṣi called śyāvāśva invited rathavīti to perform a homa at the yajña conducted by King Taranta, and when he came for the homa with his daughter the father of śyāvāśva asked him to marry his daughter to śyāvāśva. rathavīti not only refused, but also dismissed śyāvāśva from the yājñic platform. At last rathavīti married his daughter to śyāvāśva at the request of King Taranta. (ṛgveda, Sāyaṇabhāṣya).

रथीतर

RATHĪTARA . A king of the solar dynasty. He was the son of pṛṣatāśva. (bhāgavata, 9th skandha).
